package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.mapper;

import java.time.LocalDate;

/**
 * Fiscal-year helpers. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the calendar year
 * in which it began, so a date in Jul-Dec belongs to that year's fiscal year and a date in
 * Jan-Jun belongs to the previous year's.
 */
public final class Fiscal {

    private Fiscal() {
    }

    /** Calendar year the fiscal year (starting 1 July) containing {@code date} began in. */
    public static int startYear(LocalDate date) {
        return date.getMonthValue() >= 7 ? date.getYear() : date.getYear() - 1;
    }

    /** 'FY<YY>' label for the fiscal year {@code date} falls in. */
    public static String label(LocalDate date) {
        return String.format("FY%02d", startYear(date) % 100);
    }
}

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR); when present it prefixes the salutation.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner; accepted for backward compatibility and used when no addressLine1 is supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The primary structured address line; preferred over 'address' when supplied.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: An optional secondary address line, appended to the composed address when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR); when present it prefixes the salutation.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner; accepted for backward compatibility and used when no addressLine1 is supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The primary structured address line; preferred over 'address' when supplied.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: An optional secondary address line, appended to the composed address when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postcode; when present it must be valid for the city's region.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth; when present the response reports an ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner shares the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical URI of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by its id.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and last name ('<title> <lastName>'), or just the last name when no title is set.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: Unified member identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' - the region code, the two-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, the first eight upper-hex of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName), and a Luhn check digit over the digits of the preceding segments.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners at the same last name and address.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name (case-insensitively) at the time it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Derived identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate fiscal year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric level derived from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region derived from the city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'."
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The IANA timezone for the locality's region (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane); absent for other regions."
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners were registered on this owner's registration date, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already holds 40-49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The derived duplicate-detection key 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'; two owners are duplicates only when their whole keys match."

              minimum: 0

            ownerSegment:

              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR); when present it prefixes the salutation.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner; accepted for backward compatibility and used when no addressLine1 is supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The primary structured address line; preferred over 'address' when supplied.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: An optional secondary address line, appended to the composed address when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postcode; when present it must be valid for the city's region.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth; when present the response reports an ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner shares the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical URI of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by its id.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and last name ('<title> <lastName>'), or just the last name when no title is set.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: Unified member identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' - the region code, the two-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, the first eight upper-hex of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName), and a Luhn check digit over the digits of the preceding segments.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners at the same last name and address.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count

## Summary

I unified `customerCode` + `membershipNumber` into a single `memberId` formatted `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, and removed the derived `checkDigit` field.

**New cohesive helper** (`mapper/MemberId.java`) — holds all the identifier logic in one small, low-complexity class:
- `of(owner)` builds `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`: region from postcode (`Locality`), 2-digit fiscal year (`Fiscal`), the same SHA-256-over-(telephone+lastName) first-8-upper-hex `HASH8`, and a Luhn `CHK` over the digits of the preceding segments.
- `region(memberId)` / `fiscalYear(memberId)` read those segments back out (ignoring any `-<n>` collision suffix), so downstream values reference the memberId.

**Edits kept small and local:**
- `model/Owner.java` — renamed the `customer_code` field/accessors to `memberId` (trivial getters/setters only).
- `AssignOwnerMemberId` / `DeduplicateOwnerMemberId` (renamed from the `...CustomerCode` classes) — one-line delegation to `MemberId.of`, and collision handling now dedups the `memberId`. Wiring updated in `owners.POST.yml`.
- `OwnerMapper` — dropped the `membershipNumber` mapping + method; `fiscalYear` and `ownerSegment` now derive from `MemberId`; `locality`/`timezone` simplified to the plain `Locality.of(city, postcode)` (they weren't required to reference the memberId). `memberId` auto-maps by name.

- `RespondWithOwner` — removed the `checkDigit` line and its now-unused `luhn` helper.
- `openapi.yml` — replaced `customerCode` with `memberId`, removed `membershipNumber` and `checkDigit` (the DTO regenerates from this).
- All four `db/*/schema.sql` — renamed the column `customer_code` → `member_id`.

**Structural-impact choices:** the identifier logic lives in one new small class rather than being grown inside the large `OwnerMapper`; each function I touched stays trivial (mostly one-line delegations), and I avoided adding branches to any existing method.

The observed result, e.g. `memberId=NSW2616E6609E3` — `NSW` + `26` (FY26) + `16E6609E` (HASH8) + `3` (Luhn CHK).
